items.title: Verify every deployed static asset against the candidate manifest
items.why: The native CLI only enumerates TEXT_EXT. Recent releases separately compare changed images, leaving unchanged binary assets and fonts outside measured coverage.
items.recipe: Extend the existing byte comparator with an explicit all-served scope derived from the compared commit positive deployment manifest. Preserve text default compatibility, exclude provider control/stamp files, report exact scope, and verify binary mismatches, missing assets, committed inventory and invalid admission through actual HTTP/CLI fixtures.
items.acceptance: Actual CLI detects corrupt and missing non-text assets, measures unchanged binary assets, uses the compared commit manifest despite dirty configuration, preserves default text behavior and fails closed on absent/invalid manifest. Full production acceptance includes complete all-served readback.
items.userOutcome: Visitors receive the candidate images and fonts; release operators can establish full asset delivery rather than infer it from successful publishing.
items.stageRationale: Repair a proven coverage gap without changing interface, auth, pricing or lifecycle.
